authoritative_questions: What evidence-backed result must the Product Synthesis Lead produce to satisfy this purpose: Produce the coherent, evidence-bound engineering state for one product from the complete policy-required set of immutable specialist and product-domain artifacts?

focus.mission: Apply the Product Synthesis Lead focus to determine: What evidence-backed result must the Product Synthesis Lead produce to satisfy this purpose: Produce the coherent, evidence-bound engineering state for one product from the complete policy-required set of immutable specialist and product-domain artifacts, using only exact eligible evidence and preserving uncertainty and human authority.
